	Strong understanding of shop-floor workflows, basic machine operations, and safety standards.
	Good leadership, communication, and shift-coordination skills.
	Note: This position is strictly open to Ordinary National Diploma (OND) holders.

Production Supervisor Job at Vitablom




        
    

        
        Vitablom is Nigeria's leading manufacturer of hollow siliconized fibre pillow products, the finest feel of bed sheets, duvet and baby products.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Production Supervisor

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a proactive, results-driven Production Supervisor to oversee daily shift operations, coordinate factory floor teams, and ensure smooth production runs.
	The ideal candidate will maintain high quality standards, drive target achievement, and enforce shop-floor safety protocols.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee shift production output to ensure daily targets, quality standards and timelines are met.
	Allocate floor personnel efficiently across operational lines to minimize downtime and labor waste.
	Monitor shop-floor processes, enforcing strict adherence to safety (HSE), cleanliness, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
	Complete accurate shift reports capturing production output, downtime reasons, raw material usage, and scrap rates.
	Identify operational bottlenecks and collaborate with maintenance teams to address equipment faults promptly.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Educational Qualification: OND ONLY in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, or a related technical discipline. (HND, B.Sc., or higher degrees will not be considered).
	Mandatory Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of direct prior production floor experience in a manufacturing or industrial factory environment. Candidates without prior factory/production experience will be disqualified.
	Strong understanding of shop-floor workflows, basic machine operations, and safety standards.
	Good leadership, communication, and shift-coordination skills.
	Note: This position is strictly open to Ordinary National Diploma (OND) holders.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates with an OND qualification should forward their CV to: [email protected] using "Production Supervisor - OND" as the subject of the email.

Executive / Administrative Assistant Job at Accretio Africa




        
    

        
        Accretio Africa, a HR Consulting Firm, is recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Executive / Administrative Assistant

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Onsite

Role Overview


	The Executive Assistant / HR & Admin Officer will provide day-to-day executive, administrative, and HR support to the Managing Director and wider team. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, proactive, discreet, and able to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


What You'll Do
     

            
    




	Provide executive support to the Managing Director, including calendar management, meeting coordination, correspondence, and follow-ups.
	Manage day-to-day administrative activities, ensuring tasks, schedules, and priorities are properly coordinated.
	Support HR administration, including recruitment, onboarding, employee records, attendance, leave, and HR documentation.
	Coordinate internal communication and follow up with team members and stakeholders to ensure timely completion of tasks.
	Maintain accurate records and handle sensitive company and employee information with a high level of confidentiality.


Who You Are


	2–3 years of experience in Executive Assistance, HR Administration, Office Administration, or a related role.
	Strong organizational, time management, communication, and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
	Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, with strong attention to detail.
	Discreet, proactive, mature, and professional, with the ability to work confidently with senior management.
	Female candidates preferred.


Why Join Them?


	Work closely with senior leadership and gain broad exposure to business operations.
	Play a key role in supporting both executive operations and people-related activities.
	Join a growing organization with opportunities to take on increasing responsibility.
	Develop experience across executive support, HR, and administration


Salary
N230,000 / month.
